name: no-mistakes-durable-post-review-effect-a573
instr:
no-mistakes cannot durably recover post-review effects without risking repeated side effects or treating uncertain work as successful. Make effects durable with attempt- and head-bound evidence. Verify completed work, replay only demonstrably safe work, and visibly block ambiguity.

Give every run, step result, attempt, head, and operation a stable receipt. Each attempt has separate identity and history. Atomically persist receipt lifecycle with step-attempt changes so interruptions leave recoverable durable state. A begun receipt is not completion evidence.

Step-specific verification must classify recovery as verified, replayable, or blocked and preserve ambiguous evidence. Every post-review step, including TestStep, DocumentStep, LintStep, PushStep, PRStep, and CIStep, must reconcile complete causal evidence before replay. Continuous forward commit history and matching command, head, attempt, publication, provider, and observation provenance are valid. Discontinuous history, stale shared results, contradictory publication bindings, and other ambiguity block recovery.

Before publication, reconcile complete causal state across attestation, remote branch, gate mirror, local ref, and persisted publication. Block contradictions before mutation. Preserve author-controlled content and rerun expenditure. Never duplicate a verified effect. Daemon recovery considers only the pinned run's current step attempt and transports persisted receipt identity and disposition unchanged. AXI a
